title: Composer 2.5 swarm: propose annotations on new repos
description: For each new repo, spawn a Composer 2.5 agent to read source files and propose annotations (positive/negative/ambiguous) with evidence spans and labels. Output YAML annotation files.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Composer 2.5 swarm launched on remaining 9 repos: strapi, flask-login, exposed, vapor, supabase-js, auth0-express, drupal, medusa. All 19 new repos now being annotated. First batch (9 repos) complete: spring-petclinic 6, redmine 35, pocketbase 28, spree 28, orchard-core 36, directus 30, magento 35, wordpress 34, discourse 38 = 263 proposed annotations.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Composer chat proposals were not written to YAML. Reloaded 7 local Composer 2.5 writers to emit annotation files for the 17 remaining expansion repos. flask-login and spring-petclinic gold YAML is on dataparade-cli cursor/corpus-expansion-2fd9. Manifest coverage layers corrected to components/data_flows/pii_signals/data_items.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Composer writers finished. Proposed four-layer YAML is on dataparade-cli cursor/corpus-expansion-2fd9 for all 19 expansion repos. Grok on-disk span refine still running. Still proposed, not accepted.
